name: Brandy de Jerez
description: Brandy de Jerez is a Spanish brandy produced in the Sherry Triangle around Jerez de la Frontera. It is distilled from wine and aged in sherry-seasoned oak casks using a solera system, giving flavors of dried fruit, vanilla, caramel, and oak. It is consumed neat and used in cocktails where a rich, aged brandy character is desired.
